title: Glowing top hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe680' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb300' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='hatBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#8a5cff'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#b18cff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8a5cff'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='brim' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c9a8ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#7a4ce0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='band' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe680'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb300'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- outer glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='42' ry='30' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- hat brim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='40' ry='11' fill='url(#brim)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='36' ry='9' fill='#7a4ce0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='36' ry='9' fill='url(#brim)'/>

  <!-- hat body (top hat cylinder) -->
  <path d='M22 70 L22 26 Q50 16 78 26 L78 70 Z' fill='url(#hatBody)'/>

  <!-- top rim highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='26' rx='28' ry='7' fill='#d9c4ff'/>

  <!-- glowing band -->
  <rect x='22' y='56' width='56' height='10' fill='url(#band)'/>
  <rect x='22' y='56' width='56' height='3' fill='#fff6c9' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- shine streak set -->
  <path d='M31 64 L31 30' stroke='#d9c4ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
